messages:
sasha: Kicking off EU-west1 blue->green swap in the quiet window now. 5% initial shift.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: router v2.14.3 -> green pool. change_window=quiet-21:00-22:00 UTC

sam: copying release notes to #eng-releases. pinning session affinity to v2.14.3 for 24h.

clare: canary probes running (latency, 5xx, token cost). ping in 3m.

deploy-bot: Canary update: 5% -> 15% after 3m. health=ok latency_p95=48ms errors=0

matt: seeing small spike on a subset of hosts, p95 -> 140ms, CPU 70% on green n1-gpu-4.

sasha: noted. hold at 15%. rollback threshold = p95 > 120ms or errors > 0.5%

engops-rotating: grabbing logs now, will check LB config and route table.

deploy-bot: Canary update: traffic=15% hold. Auto-fallback disabled by operator.

sam: two possibilities: revert to blue or throttle warmup. prefer throttle to 30% and re-run warmup.

clare: Agree. warming kernels and increasing KV cache warmup. pushing warmup patch `warmup=true --batch=auto`

matt: If we push to 30% keep close eye on 5xx rate. schedule quick rollback if >0.2%.

sasha: Ok doing controlled bump to 30% for 10m. notify SRE if any errors. @engops-rotating please confirm LB weights applied.

engops-rotating: LB weights updated: green=30, blue=70. confirming sticky sessions preserved.

deploy-bot: Traffic split: green=30 blue=70. Monitoring logs: https://ops.example.com/runs/2721987654

clare: quick checklist: release notes updated, version pinned in router config, canary probes green. tagging release: v2.14.3-canary-2026-03-20

sam: adding note to rollout doc about manual fallback and follow-up rollback plan.

sasha: if stable after 10m we'll proceed with gradual 10% steps every 5m to 100%. if not, rollback to blue and rollback-sha `abc1234`.

matt: keep an eye on EU auth token latency — that was the hotspot last time.

engops-rotating: logs show reduced token-cache misses after warmup. p95 now ~60ms.

clare: thumbs up from probes. proceed if no regression in next 6m.

sasha: thanks all. I'll post final status when we hit 100% or rollback. :thumbsup:
